proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13291 *savēla gives Awan savēlē in the morning and Punjabi savere/savere-type adverb beside savelā/saverā early. Gojri savere/səbeḷe fit this e-vowel family, retaining the l/r correspondence, source retroflex lateral and v/b difference. This is distinct from Gujarati savār under 13290; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: səbeḷe.
